Author:     welpy-cw <h.w.forms@arcor.de>

CommitDate: Mon Jun 22 08:56:15 2026 +0000

    Bug 2048162 - Fix new mail alert appearing on wrong monitor with mixed-DPI setups. r=mkmelin
    
    The fix for bug 2034322 cached the alert window's own `screen` metrics to
    prevent monitor bleed during layout, but this fails on mixed-DPI setups
    where the OS may place the popup on the wrong monitor from the start.
    
    Instead, capture the main Thunderbird window's screen geometry and pass it
    to the alert, so `snapToCorner()` always targets the correct monitor. Falls
    back to the alert's own `screen` when the main window isn't available.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D307908

diff --git a/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js b/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
index 3eb8ca64f13..5d63e275883 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
+++ b/mailnews/base/content/newmailalert.js
@@ -70,10 +70,11 @@ async function doOnAlertLoad() {
   const alertImageBox = document.getElementById("alertImageBox");
   alertImageBox.style.minHeight = alertTextBox.scrollHeight + "px";
 
-  // Cache the target screen metrics immediately. If the window expands
-  // and temporarily bleeds into an adjacent monitor during layout,
-  // this anchors our math to the original monitor, preventing an OS hijack.
-  const targetScreen = {
+  // Use the main window's screen metrics if provided (via window.arguments[3]).
+  // This ensures the alert targets the correct monitor even on mixed-DPI setups
+  // where the OS might place the popup on a different monitor.
+  // Falls back to the alert's own screen if no target screen was provided.
+  const targetScreen = window.arguments[3]?.wrappedJSObject || {
     availLeft: screen.availLeft,
     availTop: screen.availTop,
     availWidth: screen.availWidth,
diff --git a/mailnews/base/src/MailNotificationManager.sys.mjs b/mailnews/base/src/MailNotificationManager.sys.mjs
index deeb9970d14..bdde79d3086 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/src/MailNotificationManager.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/base/src/MailNotificationManager.sys.mjs
@@ -576,6 +576,22 @@ export const MailNotificationManager = new (class {
       wrappedJSObject: newMsgKeys,
     });
     args.appendElement(this);
+
+    // Pass the main window's screen geometry so the alert positions itself on
+    // the correct monitor, even on mixed-DPI setups where the OS might place
+    // the popup on a different monitor.
+    const mainWindow = Services.wm.getMostRecentWindow("mail:3pane");
+    if (mainWindow?.screen) {
+      args.appendElement({
+        wrappedJSObject: {
+          availLeft: mainWindow.screen.availLeft,
+          availTop: mainWindow.screen.availTop,
+          availWidth: mainWindow.screen.availWidth,
+          availHeight: mainWindow.screen.availHeight,
+        },
+      });
+    }
+
     Services.ww.openWindow(
       null,
       "chrome://messenger/content/newmailalert.xhtml",
title: Bug 2048162 - Fix new mail alert appearing on wrong monitor with mixed-DPI setups. r=mkmelin
